blocks.text: Veteran actress Erlinda Villalobos, who was part of numerous films including “Ekstra” and “Manang Biring,” died on Sunday, Oct. 11, at the age of 84. Villalobos’ demise was confirmed by her family through a statement shared on her Facebook page on Sunday. The cause of death was not immediately disclosed to the public. “With a heavy heart, we announce the passing of our beloved grandmother Erlinda Villalobos,” the statement reads. “It’s never easy to say goodbye to someone who has been such a special part of our lives.
